name: Arc Picker
description: A curved text dial you drag, flick, scroll or arrow-key through, with momentum and springing brackets; Copia adds a tick dial on an inner arc, depth (far options shrink and blur), haptic detents and an accent colour prop.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, in order along the arc.

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. onValueChange fires for every option crossed while dragging or scrolling.

props.name: side
props.description: The side the arc bows toward. Top and bottom scroll sideways.

props.name: radius
props.description: Arc radius in px. Larger is gentler.

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Spacing between options along the arc.

props.name: depth
props.description: How much options shrink and blur as they curve away.

props.name: ticks
props.description: A dial of ticks on an inner arc; the selected tick takes the accent.

props.name: haptics
props.description: A short vibration on each detent, where supported.

props.name: accent
props.description: Color of the selected label, its brackets and its tick (the reference's blue by default).

props.name: name
props.description: Adds a hidden input so it works inside a form.
